mapper.select: SELECT enabled, provider_id, model_id, api_mode, base_url, api_key, provider_config, timeout_ms, updated_at FROM image_generation_settings WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image_generation_settings (id, enabled, provider_id, model_id, api_mode, base_url, api_key, provider_config, timeout_ms, updated_at) VALUES (1, #{enabled}, #{providerId}, #{modelId}, #{apiMode}, #{baseUrl}, #{apiKey}, #{providerConfig}, #{timeoutMs}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled=VALUES(enabled), provider_id=VALUES(provider_id), model_id=VALUES(model_id), api_mode=VALUES(api_mode), base_url=VALUES(base_url), api_key=VALUES(api_key), provider_config=VALUES(provider_config), timeout_ms=VALUES(timeout_ms), updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
